# User Story — End-to-End Workflow

**Purpose**: Validate the CLI command flow from project creation to benchmark, using a concrete example.

**Scenario**: Alice optimizes a job-shop scheduling problem. She wants to compare solutions generated by a local LLM (Codestral via Ollama) and a remote LLM (Claude) on the same problem and dataset.

---

## Phase 0 — Environment Setup

```bash
# Check that all dependencies are installed
$ revolver doctor

Revolver dependency check:

  Python packages:
    ✓ revolver         0.9.0
    ✓ openevolve       0.2.0

  External tools:
    ✓ ollama           0.6.2      running (http://localhost:11434)
    ✓ nvidia-smi       560.35     GPU: RTX 5090 (32 GB)

All checks passed.
```

```bash
# Register the local LLM (Ollama + Codestral)
$ revolver llm add codestral-local --source local --model codestral:22b --pull

 status    registered
 name      codestral-local
 model     codestral:22b
 source    local
 provider
 base_url

Done: LLM 'codestral-local' registered
```

```bash
# Register the remote LLM (Claude via Anthropic API)
$ revolver llm add claude-opus --source remote --provider anthropic --model claude-opus-4-6 \
    --api-key-env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY --input-cost 15.0 --output-cost 75.0

 status    registered
 name      claude-opus
 model     claude-opus-4-6
 source    remote
 provider  anthropic
 base_url

Done: LLM 'claude-opus' registered
```

```bash
# Verify both are registered
$ revolver llm list

 name              source  model            provider   base_url
 codestral-local   local   codestral:22b
 claude-opus       remote  claude-opus-4-6  anthropic
```

---

## Phase 1 — Project Creation

```bash
# Create a new project
$ revolver project init scheduling-optimizer --description "Job-shop scheduling with makespan minimization"

 status    success
 project   scheduling-optimizer
 path      /home/alice/scheduling-optimizer
 created   .revolver/, initial_program.py, evaluator.py, config.yaml, project.yaml

Done: Project 'scheduling-optimizer' initialized at /home/alice/scheduling-optimizer

$ cd scheduling-optimizer/
```

At this point, the project structure looks like:

```
scheduling-optimizer/
├── .revolver/
│   ├── revolver.db
│   ├── problem/
│   ├── datasets/
│   └── runs/
├── initial_program.py      # template with EVOLVE-BLOCK markers
├── evaluator.py            # template with dual-mode pattern
├── config.yaml             # OpenEvolve defaults
├── problem.md              # optional problem description (free-form markdown)
└── project.yaml            # project metadata
```

---

## Phase 2 — Problem Definition & Testing

Alice edits the template files to define her scheduling problem:

- **`initial_program.py`** — a naive greedy scheduler with `EVOLVE-BLOCK` markers around the heuristic
- **`evaluator.py`** — reads a job-shop instance, runs the program, computes makespan and a combined_score
- **`problem.md`** — describes the job-shop scheduling domain, constraints, and optimization objectives in natural language (injected into the LLM system prompt during `revolver run`)

```bash
# Test the evaluator on a single instance to make sure it works
$ revolver problem test --instance ./data/sample/instance_001.json

✓ Evaluator loaded successfully
✓ Instance: instance_001.json
✓ Metrics returned: {"makespan": 245.0, "combined_score": 0.28}
✓ Execution time: 0.3s
✓ No errors
```

```bash
# Test against a small dataset to catch edge cases
$ revolver problem test --dataset ./data/instances-small/

Testing 50 instances from ./data/instances-small/
✓ 48/50 instances passed
✗ instance_023.json — KeyError: 'duration' in evaluator.py:45
✗ instance_041.json — Timeout after 300s
Summary: 48 passed, 2 failed, mean time: 1.1s, max time: 4.2s
```

Alice fixes the 2 failing instances (a missing key in the evaluator and a pathological instance):

```bash
# Re-test after fix
$ revolver problem test --dataset ./data/instances-small/

Testing 50 instances from ./data/instances-small/
✓ 50/50 instances passed
Summary: 50 passed, 0 failed, mean time: 0.9s, max time: 3.8s
```

```bash
# Satisfied — create an immutable version snapshot
$ revolver problem version create --tag v1.0 --message "Initial formulation: greedy heuristic, makespan objective"

 tag          v1.0
 hash         sha256:a1b2c3d4...
 message      Initial formulation: greedy heuristic, makespan objective
 files        4
 created_at   2026-03-10 14:00:00

Done: Problem versioned as sha256:a1b2
```

---

## Phase 3 — Dataset Registration

Alice has two directories of instances: a small training set and a larger evaluation set.

```bash
# Register training dataset
$ revolver dataset add train-small --path ./data/instances-small/ --split train \
    --compatible-with v1.0 --description "50 small instances for evolution"

 status          registered
 name            train-small
 path            ./data/instances-small/
 storage         reference
 split           train
 instance_count  50
 global_hash     sha256:f1e2d3c4...

Done: Dataset 'train-small' registered (50 instances)
```

```bash
# Register evaluation dataset (larger, held-out instances)
$ revolver dataset add eval-bench --path ./data/instances-eval/ --split eval \
    --compatible-with v1.0 --description "200 instances for benchmarking"

 status          registered
 name            eval-bench
 path            ./data/instances-eval/
 storage         reference
 split           eval
 instance_count  200
 global_hash     sha256:b7a8c9d0...

Done: Dataset 'eval-bench' registered (200 instances)
```

```bash
# Verify datasets
$ revolver dataset list

 name          split  instance_count  storage
 train-small   train  50              reference
 eval-bench    eval   200             reference
```

---

## Phase 4 — Solution Generation (Two Runs)

### Run 1: Local LLM (Codestral)

```bash
# Load the local model into GPU
$ revolver llm start codestral-local

Loading "codestral-local" (codestral:22b)... done (19.4 GB VRAM, 27s)
Endpoint: http://localhost:11434/v1
```

```bash
# Launch evolution
$ revolver run --version v1.0 --llm codestral-local --dataset train-small --iterations 100 --alias codestral-v1.0

Run started: v1.0 + codestral-local + train-small
  Iteration 100/100 | Best score: 0.74 | Elapsed: 1h30m

Run completed: run-20260310-143000
  100 iterations in 1h30m
  Solution: sol-20260310-143000 (rank #1, alias: codestral-v1.0)
  Best combined_score: 0.74
  Programs stored: 3 (use `run info` to inspect, `solution extract` to promote)
  Tokens: 890,000 prompt + 215,000 completion = 1,105,000 total
  Stored in: .revolver/runs/run-20260310-143000/
```

```bash
# Free GPU memory
$ revolver llm stop

Unloaded "codestral-local" (VRAM freed: 19.4 GB → baseline)
```

### Run 2: Remote LLM (Claude)

```bash
# No need to start — remote LLMs are always ready (API key is set)
$ revolver run --version v1.0 --llm claude-opus --dataset train-small --iterations 100 --alias claude-v1.0

Run started: v1.0 + claude-opus + train-small
  Iteration 100/100 | Best score: 0.82 | Elapsed: 2h15m

Run completed: run-20260310-173000
  100 iterations in 2h15m
  Solution: sol-20260310-173000 (rank #1, alias: claude-v1.0)
  Best combined_score: 0.82
  Programs stored: 3 (use `run info` to inspect, `solution extract` to promote)
  Tokens: 1,245,000 prompt + 328,000 completion = 1,573,000 total
  Estimated cost: $43.28 (based on claude-opus pricing)
  Stored in: .revolver/runs/run-20260310-173000/
```

```bash
# See both solutions
$ revolver solution list

 id                      alias            version  llm              score   rank
 sol-20260310-143000     codestral-v1.0   v1.0     codestral-local  0.7400  #1
 sol-20260310-173000     claude-v1.0      v1.0     claude-opus      0.8200  #1
```

---

## Phase 5 — Evaluation & Benchmark

```bash
# Run a comparative benchmark on the held-out eval dataset
$ revolver benchmark --solutions codestral-v1.0,claude-v1.0 --dataset eval-bench --alias baseline-comparison

Evaluating "codestral-v1.0" on "eval-bench" (200 instances)
  [████████████████████████████████] 200/200
Evaluating "claude-v1.0" on "eval-bench" (200 instances)
  [████████████████████████████████] 200/200

Benchmark: 2 solutions on "eval-bench" (200 instances)

combined_score:
  Solution          mean    min     max     p90     std     gen_time  eval_time
  claude-v1.0       0.79    0.51    0.93    0.90    0.10    2h15m     180s
  codestral-v1.0    0.71    0.42    0.88    0.85    0.12    1h30m     165s
```

```bash
# Drill down: on which instances does Codestral beat Claude?
$ revolver benchmark results --latest --per-instance --metric combined_score --sort-by codestral-v1.0

Instance              codestral-v1.0  claude-v1.0  best
instance_087.json     0.88            0.81         codestral-v1.0
instance_142.json     0.85            0.79         codestral-v1.0
instance_003.json     0.84            0.91         claude-v1.0
...

Summary: claude-v1.0 wins on 134/200, codestral-v1.0 wins on 66/200
```

```bash
# Export raw per-instance data for custom analysis (histograms, scatter plots)
$ revolver benchmark export --latest --format csv --per-instance --output ./analysis/benchmark-raw.csv

Exported 400 rows (2 solutions × 200 instances) to ./analysis/benchmark-raw.csv
```

```bash
# Also export aggregate results
$ revolver benchmark export --latest --format json --output ./analysis/benchmark-summary.json

Exported benchmark "baseline-comparison" to ./analysis/benchmark-summary.json
```

```bash
# Clean up: delete a run and its solutions when no longer needed
$ revolver run delete run-20260310-143000 --force

Done: Run 'run-20260310-143000' deleted (including 3 solutions and run files)
```

---

## Summary — Command Sequence

| # | Phase | Command | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Setup | `revolver doctor` | Verify environment |
| 2 | Setup | `revolver llm add` (x2) | Register LLMs |
| 3 | Project | `revolver project init` | Create project |
| 4 | Problem | `revolver problem test --instance` | Quick smoke test |
| 5 | Problem | `revolver problem test --dataset` | Full validation |
| 6 | Problem | `revolver problem version` | Freeze problem definition |
| 7 | Dataset | `revolver dataset add` (x2) | Register train + eval datasets |
| 8 | Run | `revolver llm start` | Load local model |
| 9 | Run | `revolver run` (x2) | Generate solutions |
| 10 | Run | `revolver llm stop` | Free GPU |
| 11 | Benchmark | `revolver benchmark` | Compare solutions |
| 12 | Benchmark | `revolver benchmark results --per-instance` | Instance-level analysis |
| 13 | Benchmark | `revolver benchmark export` | Export for external tools |
| 14 | Cleanup | `revolver run delete` | Remove old runs |
